text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Fest, where
Tracen
students participate in various
events to entertain
their fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is also taking part in
the
festivities.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All right, these are the members who'll
run the
9,000-meter relay.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's do our best and aim for first
place!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Woooo! A beautiful team-based
competition!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But this isn't the kind of team I imagined
you'd
assemble, Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm going through Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe
footage as I usually do...
choice_data_list: I thought it might be a chance for...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
What? You're dropping out?! You finally
reached the Arc, which should've been
the beginning of a
whole new chapter in
your racing career!

text_block_list.name: Arc Racer
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain all the other Umamusume
who came
here with the same goal in
mind understand my
decision.

text_block_list.name: Arc Racer
text_block_list.text:
This is a place of aspiration and
longing—a fitting
location to set the
final chapter.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
To put it another way, people who've
never
traveled wouldn't understand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm going to be more proactive
with my
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa was likely thinking the
same as
me at that time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A simulation is just that, it doesn't
provide us a
real lived experience like
the one El Condor Pasa
had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we'll need to make up for what
we lack by
listening to the testimonies of
racers who've
taken on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why we're looking to talk with
Umamusume
who've sought to compete
on French soil.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And it seemed to us that the Fan Fest
was the
ideal place to build some
connections.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I needed to pull some strings
to get them to participate in the same
event as Nakayama Festa. But that's
nothing to complain
about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once practice for the relay race begins,
they can run together and chat during
their breaks, making
for a short but
richly productive time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So... Has this helped?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a lot. You're all really cool for
letting me
chat with you like this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Really? I get the feeling you would've
made us
talk somehow, whether we
joined you or not.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: But how could we turn you down after you approached us so passionately?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That's nice of you to say.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time for the start of our
9,000-meter
relay event! On your
marks, get set...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: HAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The baton!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué bueno! She coordinates so smoothly
with
Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may not be a natural leader, but
she's taking
on the role to gain the skills
she lacks.
choice_data_list: That just shows how hard Nakayama ...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Is she doing this all for the Arc?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship is coming in fast from behind!
Will
Nakayama Festa be able to hold on
to her lead?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the winners of our 9,000-meter
relay are...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Second place...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
We held out until the very end, but
still...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Next time, we should pay more attention
to our
pace! That will surely bring us
success!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Our pace? Trainer, did you get a video
of our
relay just now?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Good. Let's take a look at it and review
what
went wrong.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
El, you came to watch the relay. What
did you
think? Is your guidance paying
off?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! Oh, perdona. I need a little time to
think.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, that was weird.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As El Condor Pasa abruptly runs away, I
notice
her eyes are like a hawk's, deep
in contemplation.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the winners of our 9,000-meter
relay are...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! First place! Combining our
strengths
really paid off!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes. It felt like we... set a good pace.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... I'd expect no less from winners of the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Neither one of you is even out of breath.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you're truly serious about competing
in
France... then I think... you need to
learn how to
slow down and relax.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Slow down?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Right. If you're constantly packing your
schedule and pouring so much effort
into races... you won't
be able to hold
out.
choice_data_list: Do you mean beyond just your pace?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Cafe's giving timely advice!
Nakayama, make
sure you take notes!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Got it, Laurel. Cafe, can you explain any
further?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By participating in the Fan Fest,
Nakayama Festa becomes close enough
with the two racers to
casually ask them
for advice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Interviews are so draining.
choice_data_list: ...This too is proof of her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I guess.
choice_data_list: Still, we got to hear a great stor...
Still, you got to hear a great sto...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
El, you came to watch the relay. What
did you
think? Is your guidance paying
off?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! Oh, perdona. I need a little time to
think.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, that was weird.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As El Condor Pasa abruptly runs away, I
notice
her eyes are like a hawk's, deep
in contemplation.
